Bases: QMainWindow

DynamicModelEditorGUI

add_api_obj_mapping()[source]

Adds API object mapping for the main block based on the device type.

This method checks the device type of the API object. If it matches the DeviceType.LineDevice, it performs the following actions: - Creates three new variables: g, b, and bsh using the variable factory. - Assigns constant values to these variables as parameters for the main block. - Maps the power flow reference type parameters to the corresponding newly

created variables within the main block’s API object mapping.

Raises:

RuntimeError – Raised if required attributes or methods are missing.

Returns:

None
